title: Pioneer Helicopter: Sikorsky VS-300
body:
Pioneer Helicopter: Sikorsky VS-300 first flew in 1939 and became the first practical helicopter in the United States, proving Igor Sikorsky's single-rotor design with a tail rotor for control. The VS-300's success led directly to the first production helicopters of the 1940s.

The VS-300 is a public fact of aviation history, and its configuration — one main rotor, one tail rotor — remains the standard helicopter layout.

title: Heavy-Lift Helicopter
body:

Heavy-lift helicopters do work that no crane can reach, lifting loads into mountains, forests, and disaster zones.
